stages.name: access_control
stages.description: Authorization and document ownership boundaries.

stages.name: adaptive_retrieval
stages.description: Evidence assessment, score-based context sizing, and bounded retrieval decisions.

stages.name: api
stages.description: Query request validation, defaults, and input limits.

stages.name: cache
stages.description: Cache replay, scope isolation, invalidation, and capacity behavior.

stages.name: chunking
stages.description: Text preservation, configured chunk bounds, and overlap behavior.

stages.name: citation_validation
stages.description: Evidence membership and authorization for cited sources.

stages.name: embedding
stages.description: Embedding shape, deterministic fallback, finiteness, and normalization.

stages.name: end_to_end
stages.description: A query through retrieval, prompt construction, generation contract, and output checks.

stages.name: generation
stages.description: Grounded response formatting, faithfulness scoring, and answer-length adaptation.

stages.name: hybrid_retrieval
stages.description: Dense and sparse retrieval fusion, access filtering, score ordering, and top-k bounds.

stages.name: ingestion
stages.description: Loader routing, unsupported formats, and extracted-text marker preservation.

stages.name: laya
stages.description: Laya decision delegation and deterministic fallback behavior.

stages.name: llm
stages.description: Provider request contracts and per-query output token budgets.

stages.name: memory
stages.description: Short-term turn limits and persistent session/message storage.

stages.name: presidio_pii
stages.description: PII detection before query data enters the RAG pipeline.

stages.name: prompt_injection
stages.description: Direct, indirect, obfuscated, and benign-lookalike input handling.

stages.name: query_expansion
stages.description: Original-query preservation, bounded alternatives, and malformed-output fallback.

stages.name: reranking
stages.description: Candidate ordering, top-k bounds, and graceful model-unavailable fallback.

stages.name: retrieval
stages.description: Relevant-passage recall, authorization filtering, and ranked result shape.

stages.name: security
stages.description: Layered prompt-injection, PII, citation, and access-control protections.

stages.name: vector_store
stages.description: Index insert/search behavior, score ordering, and metadata association.

auxiliary_datasets.name: eval_set_v2
auxiliary_datasets.description: Legacy labeled QA/security set retained for backwards-compatible evaluator endpoints.

notes: Every stage dataset has exactly 100 uniquely identified JSONL cases.
LLM and Laya provider calls are mocked/contract-tested by default; no external service is contacted by the dashboard evaluation.
Security labels are retained as authored. Reported false positives and misses remain visible in the case results.
